overall_reason: The idea is 'show which libraries are in sync': the card does that, but the 'All files synced' toast is fused to the card's bottom edge and repeats what the rows already say.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-SIGNATURE pass on the card; T-REMOVE-DEVICE fails because removing the toast loses nothing, and the fused toast makes the frame read as one malformed object.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.where: toast under the 'Workspace sync' card, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the toast's top edge (y about 162) meets the card's bottom edge (y about 161) with no gap, so it reads as a tab of the card. Its text 'All files synced' restates 'Up to date' and '2 min ago' in the rows above.
findings.before: A toast touching the card that repeats the rows' status.
findings.after: Either drop the toast or detach it as a transient message with clear space, and let the rows carry the sync state.
findings.why: The reader sees two status signals for one fact and one shape that is neither card nor toast.

strengths: The rows pair each library with its own state ('Design library / Up to date', 'Brand assets / 2 min ago'), which is the working object of a sync panel.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
